verdict.rationale: Jira's feature docs explicitly cover tracking initiatives across teams (jira-docs-8), keeping status up to date (jira-docs-4), and prioritizing work and cultivating ownership (jira-docs-23, jira-docs-14). Customizable fields and workflows (jira-docs-3, jira-docs-13) plus board, list and timeline views (jira-docs-11) support status, priority and ownership attributes. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a dedicated initiative-level entity with an owning-team field, in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing-page claims, and independent hands-on corroboration of team-owned initiative tracking.
